manufacturer_data.description: Vendor app discovery (BleConfig.matchProduct, ConnectActivity): the manufacturer-data (AD type 0xFF) payload must start with 0x54 0x52 0x00 0x41 ("TR" + 0x0041; company_id 21076 = 0x5254 is the "TR" prefix little-endian). The app does not filter on the 0000fff0 service UUID.

Not an assigned identifier: 0x5254 little-endian spells "TR", the first two bytes of the vendor's own 54 52 00 41 advertisement prefix. See discovery below for the payload match the vendor app actually performs.

device.name: Shining Glasses
device.notes: Bluetooth-controlled LED glasses. Uses identical protocol to Shining Mask (same UUIDs, AES encryption, ASCII-based 16-byte command format, DATS/DATCP handshake). AES-128-ECB encryption via native libAES.so with a fixed default key — the 16-byte key 32672f7974ad43451d9c6c894a0e8764 was recovered verbatim from the vendor APK's libAES.so (arm64 .data, file offset 0x3008) and matches the published family key (same cdbwsoft codebase as Magic Display). Discovery: the vendor app matches manufacturer advertising data {0x54, 0x52, 0x00, 0x41} ("TR" + 0x0041), not the service UUID. Fixed 36x12 grid (SL-012 manual: 432 lamp beads; hardware captures show 1,368-byte frames = 72-byte mask + 36x12x3 RGB). FCC ID 2AOLNSL-004 (grantee 2AOLN, model SL-004 "Funky Glasses"). No pairing required. Vendor is active: app v1.2.7 updated Dec 2025; design-patent judgment won Oct 2025. CONFIDENCE: command/UUID mapping and AES key HIGH (public decompile of com.icwork.shiningglass v1.2.7, Jhan-vasquez-dev/shining-glasses, incl. HCI captures). Evidence: com/icwork/shiningglass/base/App.java:21 (keyExpansionDefault); model/data/DiyAgreement.java (command framing, REOK ack parsing).

credentials.notes: Anything within radio range can connect and issue commands. Physical proximity is the only access control.

factory_reset.effect: No credential state to clear. Power-cycling drops the current connection, which is the actual remedy for the common failure mode: the device already being connected to another central.

steps.action: Remove power (or battery) for a few seconds and reapply.
steps.expect: Device advertises again and accepts a new connection.

methods.description: No provisioning step: the device advertises as soon as it is powered on and accepts a connection from any central. There is no account, no network credential exchange and no pairing PIN, so a replacement client only has to scan, connect and write.

steps.action: Power the device and scan for its advertisement.
Connect and run the documented initialization sequence, if the spec defines one.

setup.notes: No provisioning. Commands are AES-encrypted with a fixed key, so any client that implements the framing can connect straight away.

rejoin.notes: Nothing binds this device to a network or an owner, so switching controllers is just connecting from the new one. If the old client is an Android or iOS phone, remove the device from the OS Bluetooth list as well — a cached bond can keep the phone reconnecting automatically and holding the single available link.

enter_diy_mode.description: Enter DIY drawing mode (single frame). Plaintext: [0x06, 'SMVEW', 0x01]

exit_diy_mode.description: Exit DIY mode without saving. Plaintext: [0x06, 'SMVEW', 0x00]

exit_diy_save.description: Exit DIY mode and save. Plaintext: [0x06, 'SMVEW', 0x02]

select_animation.description: Select built-in animation by index. Plaintext: [0x05, 'ANIM', index]

select_image.description: Select built-in image by index. Plaintext: [0x05, 'IMAG', index]

characteristics.name: Command
characteristics.notes: AES-128-ECB, fixed static key. Key recovered verbatim from the vendor APK's libAES.so (arm64 .data at file offset 0x3008, immediately followed by the AES S-box); identical to the family key published by Jhan-vasquez-dev/shining-glasses, the Staars gist and tayred06/shining-mask-controller. Confidence: HIGH.

services.name: Shining Glasses Service
services.notes: Single primary service holding the four d44bc439 command/transfer characteristics (hardware handle table in Jhan-vasquez-dev/shining-glasses PROTOCOL.md; the cdbwsoft BleManager binds 0000fff0 as the runtime service). There is NO separate d44bc439-...-9600 service and no FFF1 characteristic on this device.

services.name: Panchip OTA Service
services.notes: OTA service with characteristics fd01/fd02 (per Jhan-vasquez-dev/shining-glasses). The vendor APK bundles two firmware images (TR1906R04-1-10_OTA.bin, TR1906R04-10_OTA.bin) — Panchip OTA containers with a 16-byte FileInfo header; payload format not yet decoded.
